description: This file defines command-line interface commands for microphone management, including listing available microphone devices and setting a default device index. It uses AVFoundation for device discovery and has command parsing via the Commander library.

classes.name: MicCommand
classes.description: Main command grouping for microphone-related commands, including 'list' and 'set'.

classes.name: MicList
classes.description: Command to list available microphone input devices.

classes.name: MicSet
classes.description: Command to set the default microphone input device by index, with optional configuration file path.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the listing or setting of microphone devices as per the command.
